articles.description: The Lakers will be without Austin Reaves (left heel bruise) and Walker Kessler (right lower leg bruise) for Tuesday's game against the Hornets.

articles.headline: Cavaliers' Evan Mobley sidelined another 7-10 days with sprained toe
articles.description: Cavaliers forward Evan Mobley will miss at least another seven to 10 days while he recovers from a sprained right great toe.

articles.headline: Bulls' Buzelis, Nets' Minott fined $25K each after making obscene gestures
articles.description: Bulls forward Matas Buzelis and Nets forward Josh Minott have each been fined $25,000 for making obscene gestures toward the stands during their games Saturday.

articles.headline: Grizzlies' GG Jackson to miss time with left foot fracture
articles.description: Grizzlies reserve GG Jackson will miss time after breaking a bone in his left foot. He is scheduled to have surgery on the injury.
